steps.text: The exemplar separates into four drawable contacts: the outer top and right, the short upper hook, the paired left verticals joined at the base, and the inner loop into the lower right. The brush can lag its tip by over 10 mm, so I’m shaping the tip paths around the printed edges and will compare the resulting ink mask directly with the image.
